name: Create Agreement
overview: [excited] Let's set up an Agreement! Think of this... as the contract locking in PRICING and billing. [friendly] Looks like a lot, but we'll do it together. Once the basics are in, the rest falls into place!

nodes.label: Agreement Type
nodes.explanation: [curious] This is crucial! What's the deal? RENTAL_LAUNDRY means we rent them OUR linen... but LAUNDRY means they own it, and we just wash it.

nodes.label: Start Date
nodes.explanation: [casual] When does this kick in? All pricing and billing start right HERE.

nodes.label: End Date
nodes.explanation: [casual] When does it wrap up? The system STOPS applying these terms after this date.

nodes.label: Status
nodes.explanation: [casual] Simple — only ACTIVE agreements are used for billing. Need to pause it? Set it to INACTIVE.

nodes.label: Total Rooms
nodes.explanation: [casual] How many rooms here? Helps us figure out how much linen they'll ACTUALLY need.

nodes.label: Occupancy Rate
nodes.explanation: [curious] Expected occupancy? Just the percentage. Helps estimate how much LINEN is in circulation.

nodes.label: Deposit Amount
nodes.explanation: [casual] If we're RENTING... we usually collect a security deposit. Just type the amount.

nodes.label: Credit Days
nodes.explanation: [casual] Days they get to pay the rental invoice? Just pop in the number.

nodes.label: Linen Delivery Days
nodes.explanation: [casual] How many days a week do we drop off FRESH linen? Enter the number.

nodes.label: Service Frequency
nodes.explanation: [curious] How often are we doing pickup and delivery? Every day, alternate days, or a CUSTOM schedule?

nodes.label: Credit Term Days
nodes.explanation: [casual] Laundry-only customers! How many days to pay the INVOICE? Just the number.

nodes.label: Pickup Frequency Days
nodes.explanation: [casual] Days between each pickup? For example, 1 means EVERY day.

nodes.label: Delivery TAT Days
nodes.explanation: [casual] Turnaround time! Days from picking up DIRTY linen to delivering it CLEAN.

nodes.label: Billing Cycle
nodes.explanation: [casual] How often do we bill? 1 means monthly, 2 means bi-monthly... you get the idea.

nodes.label: Billing Start Day
nodes.explanation: [casual] What day does billing kick off? The 1st is the usual default.

nodes.label: Billing End Day
nodes.explanation: [casual] And when does billing wrap up? Usually the 30th or last day.

nodes.label: Billing Type
nodes.explanation: [curious] How do we charge? FLEXIBLE means we bill per item... FIXED means a flat rate every month, no matter what.

nodes.label: Fixed Monthly Amount
nodes.explanation: [casual] Flat rate it is! Just type the EXACT amount they get invoiced monthly.

nodes.name: Price Item
nodes.explanation: [excited] The meat of it — the price list! Add the products, their cost, and the service we provide.
nodes.explanationForMultiple: [friendly] Add as many products as needed — let me add a second one so you see how it looks.

children.label: Product
children.explanation: [casual] Pick the linen product. Pulls straight from your catalog.

children.label: Quantity
children.explanation: [casual] How many are we supplying or servicing? Just the number.

children.label: Price
children.explanation: [casual] Price per unit? This is what the billing is based on.

children.label: Service Type
children.explanation: [curious] What service? Washing, renting, dry cleaning? Pick what applies to this item.
children.tips: [thoughtful] Important! The SAME product can have different prices depending on the service... like washing vs renting!

children.label: Remarks
children.explanation: [casual] Special notes for this item? Quality, handling... jot it down here.

wrapUp: [warm and satisfied] And that's a wrap! [chuckles] We covered the type, timelines, commercial terms, and price list. Nothing was saved here... so when you're ready, go set up a REAL agreement. You've got this!
description: Walkthrough for creating a pricing agreement for a hotel
